angle: DL/EDGE: the 3-cone as the pass-rush lead, with Run-the-Hoop lateral force (Hoop G) as the tiebreak lead for the linemen who skip it; baseline = log pick + weight + EDGE share + NGS score + official 10-yd split and 3-cone, fit leave-one-class-out
metric_name: Hoop G: peak half-second sideways acceleration (g) while circling the Run-the-Hoop drill, z within Combine year, shrunk for one-run reliability 0.41
headline_number: Plus calls out-rushed matched no-call twins in 7 of 9 pairs (+3.2 pts of pressure rate over forecast [1.6, 4.9], shuffle p=0.004); frozen rule 4 of 9 vs 9 of 69 (p=0.05); re-chosen out of class 4 of 12 vs 9 of 66; best-of-14 p=0.12; Hoop G count model 0.6 pressures/season per sd [-0.4, 1.7]; 3-cone partial rho in-sample 0.41, leave-one-class-out 0.36 [-0.22, 0.67].
what_changed_from_previous: Football: stats scaffolding collapsed to one 3-column test table plus one sentence; new matched-twin comparison (each plus call beside the same-class, same-role no-call rusher nearest in pick and weight) as Fig 2 with pooled plus / twin / no-call / minus-flag rows; named 2023-24 hit (Cedric Johnson) and miss (Adebawore); EDGE table of high vs low hoops with 3-cone and sampled rush direction (outside/inside/straight); explicit 'what Hoop G is and is not' (null drill-to-game links stated once) and the situations it speaks to (wide-9/ghost speed rush, T-E/E-T loopers, not bull rush); film checklist per call. DS: leave-one-class-out partial rho for the 3-cone with refit bootstrap; the plus rule re-chosen (reliability and interval level) on two classes and scored on the third, with and without Downs; 2025 0-of-2 against the 2023-24 plus rate and the 2025 no-call rate (0 of 23); the -73.3 stacked OLS dropped and replaced by one count model on all 90 with separate slopes by 3-cone status under one prior; 3-cone coverage reconciled to official times on all 118 DL (43 of 118; 2025 15 of 44); broken table row fixed with an assert on cell counts. Writeup: retitled 'Two Leads', short lede, motivation with EPA cost of a pressure (0.53) and why Run-the-Hoop tracking is new, 2026 commitment moved into the ask, jargon (nats, log score, R2 pts) removed, card cut to 4 columns with a film/tie-break list, 1,615 words. Viz: Fig 1 now shows hoop path and hardest sampled NFL rush side by side on one yard scale, both coloured by g, with a single shared pressure axis and darker intervals; old Fig 2 (forest) dropped; Fig 3 replaced by the twins figure with Hoop G class strips, role colours and minus-flag row.
open_risks: The 3-cone lead is weak out of class: leave-one-class-out partial rho 0.36 [-0.22, 0.67], positive in only 1 of 3 held-out classes (2025 carries it). The lede calls it a lead, but judges may still question 'best lead'.
The matched-twin test (p=0.004) was added after the rule, on the same rushers whose 2023-24 seasons were visible when the rule was set; it is the strongest-looking number and is post hoc.
Rush direction from sampled tracking (outside/inside/straight in the first 3 yards) is a crude proxy for win type and shows no link to Hoop G (rho 0.07); bend vs power still needs film.
2025 clean test remains 0 of 2 beating forecast; one rookie season is too short (0 of 23 no-calls cleared it), so the clean class cannot discriminate.
The EPA cost of a pressure comes from sampled plays (half random) of cohort rookies only; it is descriptive, not causal.
